result.summary: Found 1 issue in the app UI regarding data display.

issues.description: The delivery fee for 'Smash Bros Burgers' displays as '€NaN', which indicates an unhandled programming error where a numeric value is expected.
issues.suggestion: Implement error handling in the frontend to display a default value (like 'Free', 'N/A', or a specific amount) instead of the technical 'NaN' string.
